# MEIKO Wellness

> MEIKO Wellness is a wellness experience store in Puchong, Selangor, Malaysia. This file summarizes the visible website content; it is not a guarantee of inclusion in AI answers.

## Official website
- [MEIKO Wellness](https://meikowellness.my/): Brand introduction, four wellness services, RM68 experience, visiting information and FAQ.

## RM68 experience
RM68 includes 4 different wellness services: foot wellness, moxibustion chair, pelvic chair and wellness capsule. Contact the store to confirm session timing, suitability and arrangements. The offer is for wellness experiences; the website does not promise medical outcomes.

## Brand
MEIKO's first store opened in 2007. MEIKO Wellness extends its customer care into modern wellness experiences.
